# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(webshot2)
library(ggrepel)

# All exports are saved here; filenames will carry date_str as a suffix
date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
export_dir <- file.path("final_exports", date_str)
dir.create(file.path(export_dir, "appendix"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
raw <- arrow::read_feather(
  "path/esi_df.feather" # file exported from extract_db.ipynb
)

df <- raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(esi_total),
    maize_grain_yield_t_ha > 0,
    !grepl("SUBTERRANEAN", water_sources),
    !(is.na(water_cons_rep_m3_ha)) | (hydric_regime == "RAINFED" & is.na(water_sources))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ca_status = as.factor(case_when(
      surface_cover_perc_harvest > 60 & !(tillage %in% c("TRADITIONAL TILLAGE")) ~ "CA",
      TRUE ~ "non-CA"
    )),
    ca_status_dummy = ifelse(ca_status == "CA", 1, 0),
    total_esi_intensity_income = esi_total / (net_income_mxn_ha * area_ha),
    total_esi_intensity_yield  = esi_total / maize_grain_yield_t,
    veg_type = factor(
      str_to_sentence(veg_type),
      levels = c("Warm climate grassland", "Temperate forest", "Tropical forest")
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_esi_intensity_ha     = esi_total / area_ha,
    land_esi_intensity_ha           = esi_land / area_ha,
    water_esi_intensity_ha          = esi_water / area_ha,
    climate_esi_intensity_ha        = esi_climate / area_ha,
    climate_albedo_esi_intensity_ha = esi_climate_albedo / area_ha
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hydric_regime = recode(hydric_regime, "IRRIGATION" = "Irrigated", "RAINFED" = "Rainfed"),
    cmt_ca        = case_when(conservation_agriculture == 1 ~ "Dataset CA", TRUE ~ "non-CA")
  )

# rm(raw)

```

## Long-form ESI data

```{r long-df, include=FALSE}
long_df <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      esi_land, esi_climate, esi_water,
      land_esi_intensity_ha, water_esi_intensity_ha, climate_esi_intensity_ha,
      land_esi_intensity_revenue, water_esi_intensity_revenue, climate_esi_intensity_revenue,
      esi_climate_albedo, climate_albedo_esi_intensity_revenue, climate_albedo_esi_intensity_ha
    ),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "esi_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_type = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "intensity_ha")      ~ "intensity_ha",
      str_detect(variable, "intensity_revenue") ~ "intensity_revenue",
      TRUE                                       ~ "absolute"
    ),
    impact_type = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "land")    ~ "Land ESI",
      str_detect(variable, "albedo")  ~ "Albedo",
      str_detect(variable, "water")   ~ "Water ESI",
      str_detect(variable, "climate") ~ "Carbon ESI"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-variable)

long_df_no_albedo <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      esi_land, esi_climate, esi_water,
      land_esi_intensity_ha, water_esi_intensity_ha, climate_esi_intensity_ha,
      land_esi_intensity_revenue, water_esi_intensity_revenue, climate_esi_intensity_revenue
    ),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "esi_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_type = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "intensity_ha")      ~ "intensity_ha",
      str_detect(variable, "intensity_revenue") ~ "intensity_revenue",
      TRUE                                       ~ "absolute"
    ),
    impact_type = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "land")    ~ "Land ESI",
      str_detect(variable, "albedo")  ~ "Albedo",
      str_detect(variable, "water")   ~ "Water ESI",
      str_detect(variable, "climate") ~ "Carbon ESI"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-variable)
```

## 4. Boxplot — ESI by vegetation type and impact type

```{r fig-3-boxplot-veg-impact}
boxplot <- long_df %>%
  filter(metric_type == "absolute") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = veg_type, y = esi_value, fill = impact_type, color = impact_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey85") +
  coord_trans(y = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.001, base = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-0.02, 0.06, by = 0.02),
```

## 5. Cumulative capture — emissions vs ESI

```{r data-4-cum-capture}
df_cum <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq), !is.na(esi_total)) %>%
  arrange(desc(net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq)) %>%
  mutate(
    frac_farms = row_number() / n(),
    cum_ghg    = cumsum(pmax(net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq, 0)) /
                   sum(pmax(net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq, 0)),
    cum_esi    = cumsum(pmax(esi_total, 0)) /
                   sum(pmax(esi_total, 0))
  ) %>%
  select(
    frac_farms,
    `GHG emissions captured` = cum_ghg,
    `ESI impact captured`    = cum_esi
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-frac_farms, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "cum")

ghg_color <- "#EE6677"
esi_color <- "#014F0E"

ghg_at_20 <- df_cum %>%
  filter(Metric == "GHG emissions captured") %>%
  slice(which.min(abs(frac_farms - 0.2))) %>%
  pull(cum)

esi_at_20 <- df_cum %>%
  filter(Metric == "ESI impact captured") %>%
  slice(which.min(abs(frac_farms - 0.2))) %>%
  pull(cum)

n_seq   <- sum(df$net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_tot   <- sum(!is.na(df$esi_total))
pct_seq <- 100 * n_seq / n_tot

note <- sprintf(
  "Note: %.1f%% plots with net negative GHG emissions (sequestration) are included as contributing zero to cumulative emissions",
  pct_seq
)
```


## 6. CA ESI/ha

The code for comparing CA plots with non-CA also includes the option to compare plots based on the native CA variable from the dataset, which here is called `cmt_ca`

### Yield quartiles

```{r data-6-stratified, include=FALSE}
stratified <- df %>%
  group_by(veg_type) %>%
  mutate(
    yield_stratum = cut(
      maize_grain_yield_t_ha,
      breaks         = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 5), na.rm = TRUE),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels         = FALSE
    ),
    stratum_mid = ave(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, yield_stratum, FUN = median)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(yield_stratum = factor(yield_stratum))

```

### Panel A - esi/ha and yield

```{r fn-6-strat-plot-ha, include=FALSE}
make_strat_plot_ha <- function(data, group_var, colors, group_label = group_var) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    group_by(veg_type, yield_stratum, .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n           = n(),
      med_esi     = median(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      yield_md    = median(maize_grain_yield_t_ha),
      stratum_mid = median(stratum_mid),
      lo          = min(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      hi          = max(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      q25         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_ha, .25),
      q75         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_ha, .75),
      yq25        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .25),
      yq75        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .75),
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(lab_vjust = if_else(
      veg_type == "Warm climate grassland" &
        yield_stratum == "1" &
        .data[[group_var]] == "non-CA",
      -3,    # push this one label below its line
      -1.8    # your original value for everything else
    ))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = yield_md, y = med_esi,
                         colour = .data[[group_var]], group = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, linewidth = (yq75 - yq25)), alpha = 0.40) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(1, 6), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n, vjust = lab_vjust,
      colour = stage(.data[[group_var]],
                     after_scale = colorspace::darken(colour, 0.4))),
  size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.10)) +
    facet_wrap(~ veg_type, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      x      = "Maize yield (t/ha) (median and IQR per yield quartile)",
      y      = "Total ESI / ha (median & IQR)",
      colour = group_label,
      title  = paste("Distribution of ESI/ha by yield stratum and", group_label)
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      plot.title            = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor      = element_blank(),
      legend.position       = "none",
      panel.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      plot.background       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
}
```

```{r fn-c3-ecdf-plot, include=FALSE}
make_ecdf_plot <- function(data, group_var, colors, group_label = group_var) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(.combo = interaction(
      factor(veg_type), factor(.data[[group_var]]),
      sep = "-", drop = TRUE
    ))

  ggplot(data, aes(total_esi_intensity_ha, color = .combo)) +
    stat_ecdf(geom = "step", linewidth = 0.7, pad = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, breaks = names(colors)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    labs(
      title  = "Cumulative distribution of ESI/ha",
      x      = "Total ESI / ha",
      y      = "Percentile per group",
      colour = "Vegetation type and CA status"
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

## 7. State aggregate

```{r data-7-state, include=FALSE}
state_df <- df %>%
  filter(year == 2021) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    esi_land                 = sum(esi_land, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_water                = sum(esi_water, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_climate              = sum(esi_climate, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_albedo               = sum(esi_climate_albedo, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_total                = sum(esi_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_land_ha              = sum(esi_land) / sum(area_ha),
    esi_water_ha             = sum(esi_water) / sum(area_ha),
    esi_climate_ha           = sum(esi_climate) / sum(area_ha),
    esi_albedo_ha            = sum(esi_albedo) / sum(area_ha),
    esi_total_ha             = sum(esi_total) / sum(area_ha),
    esi_land_yield           = sum(esi_land) / sum(maize_grain_yield_t),
    esi_water_yield          = sum(esi_water) / sum(maize_grain_yield_t),
    esi_climate_yield        = sum(esi_climate) / sum(maize_grain_yield_t),
    esi_albedo_yield         = sum(esi_albedo) / sum(maize_grain_yield_t),
    esi_total_yield          = sum(esi_total) / sum(maize_grain_yield_t),
    avg_area                 = mean(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_ha                  = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq = sum(net_ghg_emissions_tco2eq, na.rm = TRUE),
    esi_ha                   = sum(esi_total, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    yield_total_t            = sum(maize_grain_yield_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    yield_ha                 = sum(maize_grain_yield_t, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    number                   = n()
  ) %>%
  filter(number > 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(esi_total)) %>%
  mutate(state = factor(state, levels = state))

long_state <- state_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(esi_land, esi_water, esi_climate, esi_albedo),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "esi_value") %>%
  mutate(impact_type = case_when(
    str_detect(variable, "land")    ~ "Land ESI",
    str_detect(variable, "albedo")  ~ "Albedo",
    str_detect(variable, "water")   ~ "Water ESI",
    str_detect(variable, "climate") ~ "Carbon ESI"
  )) %>%
  arrange(desc(esi_total))

sina_water <- state_df %>%
  filter(state == "SINALOA")

sina_water$esi_water/sum(state_df$esi_total)
```

# SM 2

### flow diagram

```{r}
steps <- tibble(
  group  = c(rep("Yield", 2), rep("Water", 2), rep("Emissions completeness", 6)),
  reason = c("Not growing maize",
            "No reported yield",
             "Groundwater irrigation",
             "Missing water use",
             "Input amounts missing",
             "Incomplete synthetic input application emissions",
             "Incomplete synthetic input production emissions",
             "Incomplete organic input emissions",
            "Incomplete residue/harvest information",
             "Incomplete SOC emissions"),
  keep = rlang::exprs(
    crops == "MAIZE",
    maize_grain_yield_t_ha > 0,
    !grepl("SUBTERRANEAN", water_sources),
    !is.na(water_cons_rep_m3_ha) | (hydric_regime == "RAINFED" & is.na(water_sources)),
    flag_imputed_amount             %in% c("NOT APPLICABLE", "REPORTED ONLY"),
    flag_missing_emissions_syn_app  %in% c("NOT APPLICABLE | NOT MISSING", "NOT APPLICABLE", "NOT MISSING"),
    flag_missing_emissions_syn_prod %in% c("NOT APPLICABLE | NOT MISSING", "NOT APPLICABLE", "NOT MISSING"),
    flag_missing_emissions_org_app  %in% c("AVAILABLE | NOT APPLICABLE", "NOT APPLICABLE", "AVAILABLE"),
    flag_residue_emissions          %in% c("AVAILABLE", "NOT APPLICABLE"),
    flag_soc_emissions              %in% c("AVAILABLE"),
  )
)

raw %>%
  filter( crops == "MAIZE",
          maize_grain_yield_t_ha > 0,
    !grepl("SUBTERRANEAN", water_sources),
    !is.na(water_cons_rep_m3_ha) | (hydric_regime == "RAINFED" & is.na(water_sources)),
    flag_imputed_amount             %in% c("NOT APPLICABLE", "REPORTED ONLY"))

group_label <- c("Yield"                  = "Maize with reported yield",
                 "Water"                  = "Analysis sample after water filters",
                 "Emissions completeness" = "ESI score sample")

# 2. Sequential row counts: rows removed by each filter, given the previous ones
counts <- accumulate(steps$keep, \(d, k) filter(d, !!k), .init = raw) |> map_int(nrow)

steps <- steps |>
  mutate(n_after  = tail(counts, -1),
         excluded = head(counts, -1) - tail(counts, -1))

groups <- steps |>
  summarise(n_after = last(n_after), excluded = sum(excluded), n_bullets = n(), .by = group) |>
  mutate(label = group_label[group],
         h_exc = n_bullets + 2,          # title + bullets + padding (1 unit = 1 text line)
         gap   = pmax(h_exc + 2, 5))     # vertical space between consecutive blue boxes

# 3. Layout (y decreases downward)
mh <- 3  # blue box height

main <- tibble(label = c("Raw data", groups$label),
               n_obs = c(nrow(raw), groups$n_after),
               gap   = c(groups$gap, 0)) |>
  mutate(ymax = -lag(cumsum(mh + gap), default = 0),
         ymin = ymax - mh,
         ymid = ymax - mh / 2,
         fill = if_else(row_number() == n(), "#DFEEDF", "#E8EEF7"),
         yend = lead(ymax))

exc <- groups |>
  mutate(ymid  = (head(main$ymin, -1) + tail(main$ymax, -1)) / 2,
         ymax  = ymid + h_exc / 2,
         ymin  = ymid - h_exc / 2,
         title = str_glue("Excluded — {group}: n = {scales::comma(excluded)}"))

bullets <- steps |>
  left_join(select(exc, group, ymax), by = "group") |>
  mutate(y    = ymax - 1 - row_number(),
         text = str_glue("•  {reason}: {scales::comma(excluded)}"),
         .by  = group)

# 4. Plot
x_main <- c(2, 38); x_exc <- c(46, 98); xc <- mean(x_main)
y_min  <- min(main$ymin) - 1
grey   <- "grey35"

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_main[1], xmax = x_main[2], ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill),
            data = main, colour = grey) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_exc[1], xmax = x_exc[2], ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            data = exc, fill = "#FBEEE4", colour = grey) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xc, xend = xc, y = ymin, yend = yend),
               data = drop_na(main, yend), colour = grey, arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, "mm"))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xc, xend = x_exc[1], y = ymid, yend = ymid),
               data = exc, colour = grey, arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, "mm"))) +
  geom_text(aes(x = xc, y = ymid + 0.5, label = label), data = main, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(aes(x = xc, y = ymid - 0.6, label = paste0("n = ", scales::comma(n_obs))),
            data = main, size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_exc[1] + 1, y = ymax - 1, label = title),
            data = exc, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_exc[1] + 1, y = y, label = text), data = bullets, hjust = 0, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(y_min, 1), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()

p

# ggsave(file.path(export_dir, "appendix", paste0("Figure_B1.jpeg")), p, units = "in", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = "retina")
```

## TS3.1 

```{r fn-tc1-strat-table, include=FALSE}
make_strat_table <- function(plot_data, group_var, lvl1, lvl2, group_label = group_var) {
  n_l1     <- paste0("n_", lvl1)
  n_l2     <- paste0("n_", lvl2)
  esi_l1   <- paste0("med_esi_", lvl1)
  esi_l2   <- paste0("med_esi_", lvl2)
  yield_l1 <- paste0("yield_md_", lvl1)
  yield_l2 <- paste0("yield_md_", lvl2)

  plot_data_f <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(veg_type, yield_stratum, .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n           = n(),
      med_esi     = median(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      yield_md    = median(maize_grain_yield_t_ha),
      stratum_mid = median(stratum_mid),
      lo          = min(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      hi          = max(total_esi_intensity_ha),
      q25         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_ha, .25),
      q75         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_ha, .75),
      yq25        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .25),
      yq75        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .75),
      .groups     = "drop"
    )

  tbl_data <- plot_data_f %>%
    select(veg_type, n, yield_stratum, all_of(group_var), med_esi, yield_md) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = all_of(group_var), values_from = c(n, med_esi, yield_md)) %>%
    mutate(esi_pct_change = (.data[[esi_l1]] - .data[[esi_l2]]) / .data[[esi_l2]] * 100) %>%
    select(all_of(c(
      "veg_type", "yield_stratum",
      n_l2, n_l1, yield_l2, yield_l1, esi_l2, esi_l1, "esi_pct_change"
    ))) %>%
    arrange(veg_type, yield_stratum)

  tbl_data %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "veg_type") %>%
    tab_header(
      title    = md(paste0("**Maize yield and ESI/ha: ", lvl1, " vs ", lvl2, "**")),
      subtitle = "Medians per yield stratum (quartiles)"
    ) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = paste("Observations by", group_label), columns = starts_with("n_")) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "Maize yield t/ha (median)", columns = starts_with("yield_md_")) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "ESI / ha (median)", columns = c(starts_with("med_esi_"), esi_pct_change)) %>%
    tab_style(
      style     = cell_borders(sides = c("left", "right"), color = "#E0E0E0", weight = px(1)),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(starts_with("yield_md_"), starts_with("med_esi_"), esi_pct_change))
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      yield_stratum  = "Stratum",
      esi_pct_change = "% Δ",
      !!!setNames(list(lvl2, lvl1, lvl2, lvl1, lvl2, lvl1),
                  c(n_l2, n_l1, yield_l2, yield_l1, esi_l2, esi_l1))
    ) %>%
    fmt_scientific(columns = starts_with("med_esi_"), decimals = 3) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = starts_with("yield_md_"), decimals = 2) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = esi_pct_change, decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE, pattern = "{x}%") %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "—") %>%
    tab_options(
      row_group.font.weight     = "bold",
      heading.background.color  = "#2E8B57",
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      table.width               = pct(100),
      data_row.padding          = px(8),
      column_labels.padding     = px(8),
      table.font.size           = px(15)
    )
}
```

### Per hectare

```{r tbl-tc2-state-avg}
state_avg_table_data <- state_df %>%
  mutate(
    esi_total_ha   = esi_total / area_ha,
    esi_land_ha    = esi_land / area_ha,
    esi_water_ha   = esi_water / area_ha,
    esi_climate_ha = esi_climate / area_ha,
    esi_albedo_ha  = esi_albedo / area_ha,
    avg_area       = area_ha / number
  ) %>%
  select(state, number, avg_area, esi_total_ha, esi_land_ha, esi_water_ha, esi_climate_ha, esi_albedo_ha)

esi_state_avg_table <- state_avg_table_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = avg_area, decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_scientific(
    columns  = c(esi_total_ha, esi_land_ha, esi_water_ha, esi_climate_ha, esi_albedo_ha),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    state          = "State",
    number         = "n",
    avg_area       = "Average plot area (ha)",
    esi_total_ha   = "Total ESI/ha",
    esi_land_ha    = "Land ESI/ha",
    esi_water_ha   = "Water ESI/ha",
    esi_climate_ha = "Carbon ESI/ha",
    esi_albedo_ha  = "Albedo ESI/ha"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_borders(sides = "left", color = "grey80", weight = px(1)),
    locations = list(cells_column_labels(columns = -state), cells_body(columns = -state))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = list(cell_text(weight = "bold"),
                     cell_borders(sides = "right", color = "grey50", weight = px(1.5))),
    locations = list(cells_body(columns = state), cells_column_labels(columns = state))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "grey90", weight = px(0.5)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = list(cell_fill(color = impact_colors[["Land ESI"]]),
                     cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
                     cell_borders(sides = "all", color = "white", weight = px(1))),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = esi_land_ha)
  ) %>%
```

## S3.2 — Practice boxplots

```{r fn-c1-box-plot, include=FALSE}
make_box_plot <- function(data, group_var, colors, group_label = group_var) {
  plot_df <- data %>%
    select(
      .data[[group_var]], area_ha,
      residues_returned_perc_harvest, synth_fert_amount_kg_ha,
      maize_grain_yield_t_ha, net_income_mxn_ha,
      burned_perc_harvest, pesticide_amount_kg_ha,
      org_fert_dry_amount_kg_ha, water_cons_rep_m3_ha
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(maize_grain_yield_t_ha)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-.data[[group_var]], names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

  ann_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs  = sum(!is.na(value)),
      n_miss = sum(is.na(value)),
      pct_ca = mean(.data[[group_var]] != "non-CA" & !is.na(value)) /
               mean(!is.na(value)) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("n = %d \n%.1f%% CA", n_obs, pct_ca))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = value, color = .data[[group_var]], fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data        = ann_df,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.95
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(variable = var_labels)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      color = "CA status", fill = "CA status",
      title = "Distribution of key practices and outcomes, by CA status"
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.x          = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x           = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y          = element_blank(),
      strip.text            = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title            = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.background       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      panel.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
}
```

## S3.3 — GHG Fluxes

```{r data-c2-ghg-long, include=FALSE}
ghg_fluxes <- c(
  "synth_input_prod_tco2eq",
  "synth_input_tran_dist_tco2eq",
  "synth_input_app_tco2eq",
  "org_fert_app_tco2eq",
  "maize_residues_returned_tco2eq",
  "maize_grain_residues_burnt_tco2eq",
  "soc_delta_tco2eq"
)

ghg <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ghg_fluxes), ~ . / area_ha))

ghg_long <- ghg %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ghg_fluxes), names_to = "emission_type", values_to = "emission_value") %>%
  mutate(emission_type = recode(emission_type,
    "synth_input_prod_tco2eq"           = "Synthetic input production",
    "synth_input_tran_dist_tco2eq"      = "Synthetic input transport",
    "synth_input_app_tco2eq"            = "Synthetic input application",
    "org_fert_app_tco2eq"               = "Organic fertilizer application",
    "maize_residues_returned_tco2eq"    = "Maize residues returned",
    "maize_grain_residues_burnt_tco2eq" = "Maize residues burnt",
    "soc_delta_tco2eq"                  = "Soil organic carbon change"
  ))
```

```{r fn-c2-ghg-boxplot, include=FALSE}
make_ghg_box_plot <- function(data, group_var, colors, group_label = group_var) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = emission_value,
                   color = .data[[group_var]], fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ emission_type, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    labs(
      title = "CO2 emissions by emission sources",
      y     = "tCO2 eq/ha",
      color = "CA status",
      fill  = "CA status"
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
        axis.ticks.x          = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x           = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## S3.4 — CA ESI/yield

```{r fn-c4-strat-plot-yield, include=FALSE}
make_strat_plot_yield <- function(data, group_var, colors, group_label = group_var) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    group_by(veg_type, yield_stratum, .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n           = n(),
      med_esi     = median(total_esi_intensity_yield),
      yield_md    = median(maize_grain_yield_t_ha),
      stratum_mid = median(stratum_mid),
      lo          = min(total_esi_intensity_yield),
      hi          = max(total_esi_intensity_yield),
      q25         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_yield, .25),
      q75         = quantile(total_esi_intensity_yield, .75),
      yq25        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .25),
      yq75        = quantile(maize_grain_yield_t_ha, .75),
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(veg_type, yield_stratum) %>%
    mutate(lab_vjust = if_else(.data[[group_var]] == "CA", 2, -2)) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = yield_md, y = med_esi,
                         colour = .data[[group_var]], group = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, linewidth = (yq75 - yq25)), alpha = 0.40) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(1, 6), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n, vjust = lab_vjust,
      colour = stage(.data[[group_var]],
                     after_scale = colorspace::darken(colour, 0.4))),
  size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.10)) +
    facet_wrap(~ veg_type, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      x      = "Maize yield (t/ha) (median and IQR per yield quartile)",
      y      = "Total ESI / yield (median & IQR)",
      colour = group_label,
      title  = paste("Distribution of ESI/yield by yield stratum and", group_label)
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      plot.title            = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor      = element_blank(),
      legend.position       = "none",
      panel.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      plot.background       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
}
```
